## Why visit

A compact, lively stop for people interested in the beer as much as the building. Its decorative bar and raised, panelled rear area supply traditional surroundings without the scale of the city’s grand show pubs. The documented cask range makes it a natural comparison with the nearby Roscoe Head: spend enough time to choose a different style rather than automatically repeating a familiar bitter. It is especially useful as a flexible stop when walking between Lime Street and the Georgian quarter.

## Beer

CAMRA lists regular cask including Oakham Citra and Titanic Plum Porter, with changing guests; these are documented examples, not a November promise.
